changelog: Aura AI v2.4.4 — Minimalist Voice Screen, RGB Particle Orb & Spoken Chat Switcher
Streamlined Home Suggestions: Exactly 3 clean prompt pills on empty state (removed 'Phone automation & tasks')
Minimalist Dynamic Voice Header: Clean greeting title only ('Good morning, $Name'); completely eliminated subtitle clutter and in-flight transcript from header
Perfect Orb Centering: 3D Orb now sits in the exact vertical center between header and bottom dock
Continuous RGB Rainbow Animation: Dynamic WebGL color spectrum cycling continuously across particle volume, celestial rings, and cosmic dust
Live Status on Bottom Dock: Clean real-time status (Speak to ask, Listening, Thinking, Working, Speaking, Muted) displayed directly on the center button
Open Renamed Chats by Voice: Aura AI now supports open_chat_by_name to instantly find and display any renamed chat or voice session when spoken by title
